sanskrit_verse:
यथाकामी भवेद् वापि स्त्रीणां वरमनुस्मरन् ।
स्वदारनिरतश् चैव स्त्रियः रक्ष्या यतः स्मृताः ॥
transliteration: yathākāmī bhaved vāpi strīṇāṁ varam anusmaran / svadāranirataś caiva striyo rakṣyā yataḥ smṛtāḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Even if a woman wishes otherwise, recalling her chosen husband, she remains protected because she is devoted to her own spouse.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious choice and alignment with Dharma
Causation arises through inner commitment, not external compulsion
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by self-awareness and integrity
Restoration logic prioritizes relational harmony over punitive enforcement
Consciousness alignment ensures that protection follows authentic consent
executable_legal_axioms: IF a woman has made a conscious selection of union AND maintains fidelity to that selection THEN legal protection is automatically invoked without need for punitive enforcement
IF deviation occurs due to lack of awareness THEN restoration includes capacity-building protocols rather than punitive measures
IF societal disruption arises from misalignment THEN corrective action shall realign consciousness, not impose suffering
supreme_court_application: In matters involving marital fidelity or personal autonomy, the threshold of responsibility lies in the clarity and consistency of one's inner alignment. The court must recognize that true protection stems from internal commitment, which supersedes coercive frameworks.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Protection is not enforced through fear or penalty but emerges naturally when consciousness aligns with chosen truth. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how inner resolve manifests as outer stability. Responsibility is proportional to awareness; thus, correction focuses on awakening, not punishing.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reaffirmation of voluntary commitment through guided introspection
Community-based integration support for relational coherence
Education programs emphasizing freedom rooted in self-discipline
Mediated reconciliation where dissonance disrupts social fabric
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Protection flows from alignment, not coercion. Justice restores consciousness, never punishes it. Reality itself upholds those who abide in their chosen truth.
